title: Reused ReadIndex context completed by a stale heartbeat acknowledgement
cause: advance now deletes released requests (read_only.go:100-104), so addRequest accepts the same context again in the same term, and recvAck attributes any in-flight MsgHeartbeatResp carrying that context to the new request.
trigger: Release a ReadIndex for context C while another follower's ack for the same heartbeat round is delayed; a newer leader commits; the old leader accepts ReadIndex C again; the delayed ack arrives.
consequence: The old leader returns a ReadState whose index is below an entry committed before the request was issued (stale, non-linearizable read).
premises: The caller may reuse a ReadIndex context after the earlier request with that context completed (no API precondition forbids it).
Heartbeat acknowledgements can be delayed or duplicated (network delay; periodic MsgBeat carries the last pending context).
The old leader has not yet stepped down when the delayed acknowledgement arrives.
